title: Exoskeleton and Spinal Cord Stimulation for SCI
official: Exoskeleton and Spinal Cord Stimulation for SCI
summary: The overall aim of this project is to assess the effect of combining transcutaneous lumbosacral stimulation (TLS) during Exoskeleton Assisted Walking (EAW) compared to EAW alone without stimulation on walking recovery.
